description: Fork of exp024 with out_output_nap 72 → 32. Tests whether exp024's slow descent is partly driven by out_proj's wider votes-per-pair budget (57.7 → 25.6) — each individual vote contributes ~0.7× the gradient signal at output_nap=72 vs 32, which slows latent growth past the STE gate threshold. Same H=6, d_qk=24, d_v=12, joint Q/K, E=72 sum-mode pos. Bit latents drop ~226M → ~101M (out_proj is the dominant bucket).
